name: workflow decisions from journeys

not_learned.map.size: its state holds the rules' own drawing (the parts and the template): a classifier on it can only copy the rules
not_learned.map.edit: the person's own change to the map: an action recorded, not a decision DCLab makes
not_learned.problem.pack: only two problem kinds declare a pack, too few to learn from
not_learned.workflow.template: drawn from the pack by a fixed table: there is nothing to learn
not_learned.workflow.move: the workflow graph's validator owns it: no model decides a move (principle 1 of the plan)
not_learned.workflow.revisit: a person's or an agent's request to run a stage again: no journey asks for one
not_learned.workflow.stage_approval: the written person approves every gate: the labels would carry no information
not_learned.workflow.stop: no agent with a model runs in a journey; its labels come from recorded sessions' outcomes (27.2)
not_learned.agent.tool_choice: no agent with a model runs in a journey; its labels come from recorded sessions' outcomes (27.2)
not_learned.experiment.next: the engine's own improvement loop: labelled by its measured results, not by a journey
not_learned.solution.compose: labelled where it is decided, by the holdout's measured comparison (24.7)
not_learned.command.intent_route: not decided by the studio yet
not_learned.proposal.completeness: not decided by the studio yet

rule: Rows of written journeys played on the rules alone (no model, no routed model, no shadow); each label is the set of answers its journey accepts, never DCLab's answer, and the rules are scored right when their answer is in it. A person (a set and an id) is in one split. Rebuilt by `python -m dclab_rnd.workflow_models collect` (and `relabel` from its plays); the rows are not committed.
